    },
    {
      "name": "mining",

      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not modify block assembly or mining interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly hardens P2P transaction and block deserialization against resource exhaustion, and updates P2P deserialization to immediately fail transactions with zero inputs or outputs.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.88,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Mitigates a severe message handling DoS vulnerability reported by researchers where an attacker can flood nodes with 4 MB blocks that consume over 110 MB memory and hundreds of milliseconds of CPU to deserialize. Author benchmarks show deserialization time of crafted blocks drops from up to 317 ms down to 13.5 ms."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change RPC interfaces, commands, or caller expectations."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Added benchmarks and fuzz harnesses in src/bench and src/test/fuzz specifically support the witness serialization change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test updates directly verify and pin the CScriptWitness changes rather than modifying shared test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/bitcoin-tx.cpp follow mechanically from CScriptWitness method changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter tool functionality or developer scripts."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/serialize.h to support serialized witness handling, but the change is primarily a transaction primitive redesign.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "General serialization helpers are extended solely to serve transaction and witness validation structures."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Redesigns CScriptWitness and transaction primitive deserialization in src/script/script.h and src/primitives/transaction.h to eliminate block validation DoS vectors.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.92,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Prevents adversarial memory and CPU exhaustion during block validation where a crafted 4 MB block could consume 112 MB of memory and 317 ms of CPU time. Author benchmarks demonstrate memory dropping from 112 MB to 4.0 MB and deserialization time dropping by an order of magnitude."
